settlement_source: Governing league (NBA, nba.com) first official final result; Source Agencies: league, AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports (TITLE.pdf)
settlement_variable: Which team wins the NBA Finals (holds the title) for the specified year (e.g. 2027)
tie_handling: If multiple teams reported title holders: Yes pays $1/N rounded down, No = $1 minus Yes.
rounding: Rounded down to nearest cent; min tick $0.01
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading = expiration time (10:00 AM ET, day after official final result at latest). API close/expiration 2029-07-30T14:00Z is a far backstop; can_close_early=1 so it closes early once result is official. Settlement within a day; timer 300s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed/suspended: stays open until winner reported or 2 years after original date. Cancelled/no contest: eligible (non-eliminated) teams pay $1/N. Forfeit => No. Disqualified before expiry => No. Team eliminated (as reported by Source Agency) => No immediately. Event ended early but governing body declares winner => that result. Post-expiry revisions ignored. Kalshi sole-discretion Outcome Review; Rule 6.3(b) fallback.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Generic 'Pro Basketball' wording; actual league (NBA) evident only from source URL; PDF <title> may be NFL/NHL/NBA/NCAA
close_time 2029-07-30 is a placeholder far beyond Finals (~June 2027)
Elimination resolves an individual team No before the Finals end
toxicity_flags: Insider list (players, coaches, staff, owners): injury/rotation MNPI
